instruction: My work meeting files are available in the "~/documents/work/meetings_files/" directory in my file system. Currently, they are organized as "<date>__<file_name>.<extension>". Reorganize them in this format, "<file_name>/<date>.<extension>".
notes: Only file_system (plus supervisor) is needed. The files in the meetings directory are unknown until file_system.show_directory lists them, so the problem uses one representative file object (meeting-file) whose old path, new sub-directory and new path are static facts; at execution time the create_directory + move_file pair is instantiated once per listed file (create_directory only once per distinct <file_name>, or with allow_if_exists=true), with show_directory listing done once. create_directory requires the directory listing (names derive from it) and move_file requires the target directory to exist; move_file preserves file content, matching the evaluation which checks that each <date>__<file_name>.<ext> file's content now lives at <file_name>/<date>.<ext> and that all other files are untouched. The task asks no question, so complete_task is called without an answer; its extra ?f parameter is the task record only.
